description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature for articles, including command handling for editing article details, validation, and database interactions such as updating fields, managing tags, and saving changes.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Main class encapsulating the functionality for editing articles, including command definition, validation, and handling logic.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the edit command, updates the article and associated tags in the database, and returns the updated article envelope.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be added to the article based on the provided tag list.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Determines which tags should be removed from the article based on the provided tag list.
